role.zh: 腾讯首席 AI 科学家

why.en: First author of ReAct and Tree of Thoughts, and co-author of SWE-bench and WebShop. Nearly every agent framework's reason-act loop descends from his work. Left OpenAI to lead Tencent's newly merged foundation model department.
why.zh: ReAct 与 Tree of Thoughts 的第一作者，也是 SWE-bench 与 WebShop 的共同作者。当前几乎所有 Agent 框架的推理—行动循环都源自其工作。已离开 OpenAI，执掌腾讯新合并的基础模型部。

title.en: The Second Half
title.zh: 下半场

note.en: The argument that evaluation now matters more than training — one of the most widely repeated theses in agent research.
note.zh: 主张评测比训练更重要 —— Agent 研究中被复述最多的论断之一。

title.en: Hy ai4s is hiring :)
title.zh: Hy ai4s is hiring :)

note.en: Yao announced his Hunyuan AI4Science team at Tencent is hiring, a signal of the group he is building out under the newly merged foundation model department.
note.zh: 姚顺雨宣布腾讯混元AI4Science团队正在招聘，显示出他在新合并的基础模型部门下组建团队的进展。

title.en: 115. 对OpenAI姚顺雨3小时访谈：6年Agent研究、人与系统、吞噬的边界、既单极又多元的世界
title.zh: 115. 对OpenAI姚顺雨3小时访谈：6年Agent研究、人与系统、吞噬的边界、既单极又多元的世界

note.en: Shunyu Yao gives a three-hour interview on his six years of agent research, the human-system boundary, and a world both unipolar and pluralistic.
note.zh: 姚顺雨接受三小时访谈，畅谈六年Agent研究、人与系统的边界，以及"既单极又多元"的世界。

title.en: Hy2 -> Hy3 preview -> Hy3 Another massive leap forward, under half a year. Not just a leap of reasoning or agentic capabilities. Also a leap of anti-hallu
title.zh: Hy2 -> Hy3 preview -> Hy3 Another massive leap forward, under half a year. Not just a leap of reasoning or agentic capabilities. Also a leap of anti-hallu

note.en: Yao described the rapid Hy2-to-Hy3 progression as a major leap not just in reasoning and agentic ability but in reliability and reduced hallucination, framing the pace of Hunyuan's model iteration.
note.zh: 姚顺雨称混元从Hy2到Hy3的快速迭代不仅是推理和智能体能力的飞跃，也是可靠性提升和幻觉减少的重大进步，展现了混元模型迭代的速度。

title.en: 汤道生x姚顺雨对谈：腾讯AI下半场
title.zh: 汤道生x姚顺雨对谈：腾讯AI下半场

note.en: In a public dialogue with Tencent CSIG CEO Tang Daosheng, Shunyu Yao argued AI's 'second half' is just beginning and that the core challenge has shifted from method to finding problems worth solving.
note.zh: 姚顺雨与腾讯CSIG CEO汤道生公开对谈，提出AI"下半场"才刚刚开始，核心矛盾已从方法论转向寻找值得解决的真问题。

title.en: CL-bench Life: Can Language Models Learn from Real-Life Context?
title.zh: CL-bench Life: Can Language Models Learn from Real-Life Context?

note.en: Extends his context-learning benchmark to everyday personal settings, testing whether assistants actually learn from real-life context.
note.zh: 把其上下文学习基准扩展到日常生活场景，检验助手能否真正从真实生活情境中学习。

title.en: Our goal is to build practical models with comprehensive capabilities beyond open benchmarks. And the only way to do it to co-design with diverse products while
title.zh: Our goal is to build practical models with comprehensive capabilities beyond open benchmarks. And the only way to do it to co-design with diverse products while

note.en: Yao laid out Hunyuan's strategy: building practical, broadly capable models by co-designing with real products at scale rather than chasing open benchmarks, a post that drew nearly a million views.
note.zh: 姚顺雨阐述了混元的策略：通过与实际产品大规模协同设计来打造实用、能力全面的模型，而非一味追逐公开基准测试，该帖子浏览量接近百万。

title.en: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning
title.zh: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning

note.en: Benchmark measuring whether language models can learn from task-specific context instead of relying on pretrained knowledge.
note.zh: 提出评测语言模型能否从任务上下文中学习、而非仅依赖预训练知识的基准。

title.en: 腾讯姚顺雨、Qwen林俊旸、智谱唐杰的AGI-Next圆桌对话, 2026
title.zh: 腾讯姚顺雨、Qwen林俊旸、智谱唐杰的AGI-Next圆桌对话, 2026

note.en: At the closed-door AGI-Next summit, Shunyu Yao joined a roundtable with Zhipu's Tang Jie, Moonshot's Yang Zhilin and Qwen's Lin Junyang to debate paradigm shifts, agents and China's odds in the AI race.
note.zh: 在AGI-Next闭门峰会上，姚顺雨与智谱唐杰、月之暗面杨植麟、Qwen林俊旸同台圆桌，探讨范式变革、智能体与中国AI的胜算。

title.en: How to evaluate llms when we can’t trust benchmark numbers anymore?
title.zh: How to evaluate llms when we can’t trust benchmark numbers anymore?

note.en: Poses the evaluation problem behind his Second Half thesis: how to judge language models once benchmark numbers can no longer be trusted.
note.zh: 提出「下半场」论述背后的核心难题：当基准分数不再可信，该如何评估大模型。

title.en: An awesome piece by @_kevinlu . I find lots of the points connected to my own post https://t.co/WddJkbSfks Pre-training is a genius idea that essentially levera
title.zh: An awesome piece by @_kevinlu . I find lots of the points connected to my own post https://t.co/WddJkbSfks Pre-training is a genius idea that essentially levera

note.en: Connects Kevin Lu's essay to his own argument that pre-training worked because it leveraged the output of billions of people rather than a handful of annotators.
note.zh: 呼应 Kevin Lu 的文章，并接上他自己的论点：预训练之所以奏效，是因为它借用了数十亿人的产出，而非少数标注者的劳动。

title.en: Contextual Experience Replay for Self-Improvement of Language Agents
title.zh: Contextual Experience Replay for Self-Improvement of Language Agents

note.en: Lets language agents self-improve by distilling past trajectories into reusable in-context experience, tested on web navigation.
note.zh: 让语言智能体把过往轨迹提炼成可复用的上下文经验，从而自我改进，在网页导航任务上验证。

title.en: When Models Know More Than They Can Explain: Quantifying Knowledge Transfer in Human-AI Collaboration
title.zh: When Models Know More Than They Can Explain: Quantifying Knowledge Transfer in Human-AI Collaboration

note.en: Studies whether stronger model reasoning also transfers as usable knowledge to human collaborators.
note.zh: 研究模型推理能力增强后，能否把知识有效传递给与之协作的人类。

title.en: Check out our coding agent, which sets new sota on swebench! What agent next?
title.zh: Check out our coding agent, which sets new sota on swebench! What agent next?

note.en: Announces that the coding agent he worked on set a new state of the art on SWE-bench, the benchmark he co-authored.
note.zh: 宣布他参与的编程智能体在 SWE-bench 上刷新最好成绩，而该基准正是他的共同作品。

title.en: An impression for existential AI risk: it’s rather controllable in single-agent (ReAct) setups, where reading human-like sequential traj is doable albeit tediou
title.zh: An impression for existential AI risk: it’s rather controllable in single-agent (ReAct) setups, where reading human-like sequential traj is doable albeit tediou

note.en: His stated view on existential AI risk: readable and largely controllable in single-agent ReAct-style loops, much harder to inspect once agents interact.
note.zh: 他对 AI 存在性风险的公开看法：单智能体 ReAct 式回路的轨迹尚可读、可控，多智能体交互一旦出现就难以审视。

title.en: We’re releasing - CUA, the first agent model from OpenAI - Operator, the first agent product from OpenAI - https://t.co/64dDnCi0sC , the first agent job post fr
title.zh: We’re releasing - CUA, the first agent model from OpenAI - Operator, the first agent product from OpenAI - https://t.co/64dDnCi0sC , the first agent job post fr

note.en: Announces OpenAI's release of CUA and Operator, its first agent model and first agent product, which he helped build.
note.zh: 宣布 OpenAI 发布 CUA 与 Operator——公司首个智能体模型与首款智能体产品，他参与其中。

title.en: Tree of thoughts is not about llm/cot cant solve game of 24, or you have to use complex prompt engineering or control flow to do it. It’s about multiagent in so
title.zh: Tree of thoughts is not about llm/cot cant solve game of 24, or you have to use complex prompt engineering or control flow to do it. It’s about multiagent in so

note.en: Corrects a common misreading of his own Tree of Thoughts paper, framing it as search at test time rather than prompt engineering.
note.zh: 澄清外界对他《思维树》论文的常见误读：论文讲的是测试时的搜索，而不是提示工程技巧。

title.en: I think the biggest surprise for me in 2024 is that small models can also generalize
title.zh: I think the biggest surprise for me in 2024 is that small models can also generalize

note.en: His takeaway from 2024: the biggest surprise was that small models generalize too.
note.zh: 他对 2024 年的总结：最大的意外是小模型同样能够泛化。

title.en: It seems increasingly clear "agi" wont be a singularity point event thing, unless we fundamentally break the train test barrier from traditional ml
title.zh: It seems increasingly clear "agi" wont be a singularity point event thing, unless we fundamentally break the train test barrier from traditional ml

note.en: Argues AGI will not arrive as a single singularity-style event unless the train/test boundary inherited from traditional machine learning is broken.
note.zh: 他认为，除非打破传统机器学习遗留的训练/测试界限，AGI 不会以奇点式的单一事件到来。

title.en: Had a fun time delivering language agent tutorial (https://t.co/UlDj9S4BfC) with @ysu_nlp @Diyi_Yang @taoyds @emnlpmeeting ! Thanks for joining and asking good
title.zh: Had a fun time delivering language agent tutorial (https://t.co/UlDj9S4BfC) with @ysu_nlp @Diyi_Yang @taoyds @emnlpmeeting ! Thanks for joining and asking good

note.en: Marks the language-agent tutorial he co-delivered with collaborators at EMNLP 2024, with the materials linked.
note.zh: 记录他与合作者在 EMNLP 2024 共同讲授的语言智能体教程，并附上教程材料。

title.en: My mental model of a good paper: 1. Solves some questions 2. Opens up new questions or directions for future research Reviewers nowadays: - Ignores things in 1
title.zh: My mental model of a good paper: 1. Solves some questions 2. Opens up new questions or directions for future research Reviewers nowadays: - Ignores things in 1

note.en: His standard for a good paper — it answers a question and opens new ones — together with a criticism of how reviewers weigh the two.
note.zh: 他心目中好论文的标准——既解决问题，又开启新的方向——以及对当下评审只盯前者的批评。

title.en: almost forget to post: i've joined @OpenAI! time to convert the research vision to reality, and expect something exciting to drop out :)
title.zh: almost forget to post: i've joined @OpenAI! time to convert the research vision to reality, and expect something exciting to drop out :)

note.en: Yao announced he joined OpenAI to work on turning language-agent research into real products.
note.zh: 姚顺雨宣布加入OpenAI,致力于将语言智能体的研究愿景转化为现实产品。

title.en: Excited to share what I did @SierraPlatform with @noahrshinn pedram and @karthik_r_n ! 𝜏-bench evaluates critical agent capabilities omitted by current benchmar
title.zh: Excited to share what I did @SierraPlatform with @noahrshinn pedram and @karthik_r_n ! 𝜏-bench evaluates critical agent capabilities omitted by current benchmar

note.en: Yao introduced tau-bench, a new benchmark built with Sierra to evaluate agent capabilities like robustness and complex rule-following that existing benchmarks miss.
note.zh: 姚顺雨发布了与Sierra合作推出的τ-bench基准,用于评估现有基准所忽略的智能体能力,如鲁棒性和复杂规则遵循。

title.en: misalignment of ai and humans is not as dangerous as misalignment of our own behavior and desire, or misalignment among our various desires, or misalignment amo
title.zh: misalignment of ai and humans is not as dangerous as misalignment of our own behavior and desire, or misalignment among our various desires, or misalignment amo

note.en: Yao argued AI-human misalignment is less dangerous than the misalignment within humans' own behavior and desires, or among people's differing desires.
note.zh: 姚顺雨提出观点:AI与人类之间的不一致,其危险程度不及人类自身行为与欲望之间的不一致,或人与人之间欲望的不一致。

title.en: I've defended my PhD! "Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation" - Talk (WebShop, SWE-bench, ReAct, ToT, CoALA, and on the future of ag
title.zh: I've defended my PhD! "Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation" - Talk (WebShop, SWE-bench, ReAct, ToT, CoALA, and on the future of ag

note.en: Yao announced defending his PhD thesis, 'Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation,' covering WebShop, SWE-bench, ReAct, Tree of Thoughts and CoALA.
note.zh: 姚顺雨宣布完成博士论文答辩,题目为《语言智能体:从下一词预测到数字自动化》,涵盖WebShop、SWE-bench、ReAct、思维树(ToT)和CoALA等工作。

title.en: SWE-agent paper: https://t.co/H8gKlbzl1m If you care about - SWE: check detailed design & analysis - agents: check principles & insights for agent-compu
title.zh: SWE-agent paper: https://t.co/H8gKlbzl1m If you care about - SWE: check detailed design & analysis - agents: check principles & insights for agent-compu

note.en: Yao described the SWE-agent paper's design and the agent-computer interface (ACI) concept, connecting it to software engineering and HCI/cognitive science.
note.zh: 姚顺雨介绍了SWE-agent论文的设计,提出智能体-计算机接口(ACI)概念,并将其与软件工程及人机交互/认知科学相联系。

title.en: Coding is the frontier of AI. Excited to push the two frontiers of AI coding: 1. SWE(-bench/agent) 2. Olympiad programming (this tweet) Introduce USACO benchmar
title.zh: Coding is the frontier of AI. Excited to push the two frontiers of AI coding: 1. SWE(-bench/agent) 2. Olympiad programming (this tweet) Introduce USACO benchmar

note.en: Yao introduced the USACO benchmark for olympiad-level programming, extending his push on AI coding alongside SWE-bench/SWE-agent.
note.zh: 姚顺雨发布了面向奥林匹克编程水平的USACO基准,延续了他在SWE-bench/SWE-agent之外对AI编程能力的推进。

title.en: When I first saw Tree of Thoughts I also asked myself this😀 great exploration into if next-token prediction can simulate search, and if you're interested in thi
title.zh: When I first saw Tree of Thoughts I also asked myself this😀 great exploration into if next-token prediction can simulate search, and if you're interested in thi

note.en: Yao commented on a follow-up exploring whether next-token prediction can simulate search, connecting it to his Tree of Thoughts work.
note.zh: 姚顺雨评论了一项探讨下一词预测能否模拟搜索的后续研究,并将其与自己的思维树(Tree of Thoughts)工作联系起来。

title.en: Swe-agent achieves ~ Devin while only using < 2min and $4 per case
title.zh: Swe-agent achieves ~ Devin while only using < 2min and $4 per case

note.en: Yao reported that SWE-agent matches Devin's performance while costing about $4 and under 2 minutes per case.
note.zh: 姚顺雨指出,SWE-agent在效果上接近Devin,但每个案例仅需约4美元和不到2分钟。

title.en: Extremely excited to open-source our SWE-agent that achieves SoTA on SWE-bench😃 Turns out ReAct + Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) can go a long way, very excited
title.zh: Extremely excited to open-source our SWE-agent that achieves SoTA on SWE-bench😃 Turns out ReAct + Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) can go a long way, very excited

note.en: Yao announced open-sourcing SWE-agent, which achieves state-of-the-art results on SWE-bench by combining ReAct with an agent-computer interface.
note.zh: 姚顺雨宣布开源SWE-agent,该系统结合ReAct与智能体-计算机接口(ACI),在SWE-bench上取得了当时最优结果。

title.en: Is it just me or haystack is too stupid for benchmarking long context capabilities? If swe-bench is too hard, at least we need tasks that require reasoning over
title.zh: Is it just me or haystack is too stupid for benchmarking long context capabilities? If swe-bench is too hard, at least we need tasks that require reasoning over

note.en: Yao critiqued the 'needle in a haystack' test as inadequate for benchmarking long-context reasoning, arguing for tasks requiring reasoning across multiple parts of long context.
note.zh: 姚顺雨批评'大海捞针'测试不足以衡量长上下文推理能力,主张应设计需要跨长文本多个部分进行推理的任务。

title.en: Solving >10% of our SWE-Bench (https://t.co/gP4rgwPDK3) is THE most impressive result in 2024 so far, and a milestone for the research and application of AI
title.zh: Solving >10% of our SWE-Bench (https://t.co/gP4rgwPDK3) is THE most impressive result in 2024 so far, and a milestone for the research and application of AI

note.en: Yao called Cognition Labs solving over 10% of SWE-Bench, the benchmark he co-created, the most impressive AI agent result of 2024 so far.
note.zh: 姚顺雨称赞Cognition Labs在他参与创建的SWE-Bench上解决超过10%的问题,是2024年迄今AI智能体领域最令人印象深刻的成果。

title.en: Benchmark will be bipolar, objective ones will all be evaluated by code execution, subjective ones human preference (and maybe human simulater)
title.zh: Benchmark will be bipolar, objective ones will all be evaluated by code execution, subjective ones human preference (and maybe human simulater)

note.en: Yao predicted benchmarks will split in two: objective ones evaluated by code execution, subjective ones by human (or simulated human) preference.
note.zh: 姚顺雨预测未来基准测试将分化为两类:客观类通过代码执行评估,主观类则依赖人类(或模拟人类)偏好评估。

title.en: IMO the most important aspect of video generation is coherent long horizon. It is an indication of capturing the world dynamics beyond pixels, and an important
title.zh: IMO the most important aspect of video generation is coherent long horizon. It is an indication of capturing the world dynamics beyond pixels, and an important

note.en: Yao argued coherent long-horizon generation is the most important aspect of video models, seeing it as a step toward capturing world dynamics and 'world models.'
note.zh: 姚顺雨认为,连贯的长时程生成是视频生成模型最重要的方面,并将其视为捕捉世界动态、迈向'世界模型'的关键一步。

title.en: Cool work and great extension of WebShop (https://t.co/eCk9bpOP9w) --- We've been thinking about making it personalized for some years, it's great someone start
title.zh: Cool work and great extension of WebShop (https://t.co/eCk9bpOP9w) --- We've been thinking about making it personalized for some years, it's great someone start

note.en: Yao praised a personalization extension of his WebShop benchmark, noting his team had long considered building that direction themselves.
note.zh: 姚顺雨称赞了一项对其WebShop基准的个性化扩展工作,并提到团队早就设想过朝这个方向发展。

title.en: 129 - Transformers and Hierarchical Structure, with Shunyu Yao
title.zh: 129 - Transformers and Hierarchical Structure, with Shunyu Yao

note.en: An early interview where Yao discussed his research on how transformers represent bounded-depth hierarchical structure in language, before his later work on ReAct and agents.
note.zh: 姚顺雨在ReAct与智能体研究之前的一次早期访谈，探讨了Transformer如何表示语言中有限深度的层级结构。

title.en: Ungrounded Meaning
title.zh: Ungrounded Meaning

note.en: An early blog post responding to work on whether a language model can acquire meaning from ungrounded form alone.
note.zh: 早期博文，回应「语言模型能否仅凭无指涉的形式习得意义」这一问题的相关研究。

title.en: Joins Tencent as Chief AI Scientist
title.zh: 加入腾讯任首席 AI 科学家

body.en: Tencent merged its Hunyuan multimodal and LLM divisions into a single Foundation Model Department under him — part of a broader wave of Chinese labs recruiting from US frontier labs.
body.zh: 腾讯将混元多模态与大语言模型两个部门合并为基础模型部由其统领 —— 属于中国实验室从美国前沿实验室大举招募的更大浪潮。

title.en: 消息称田永龙进入腾讯CEO办公室，向姚顺雨汇报
title.zh: 消息称田永龙进入腾讯CEO办公室，向姚顺雨汇报

body.en: Tian Yonglong reportedly moved into Tencent's CEO office and now reports to Shunyu Yao, expanding his organizational reach.
body.zh: 据报道田永龙进入腾讯CEO办公室，向姚顺雨汇报，姚顺雨的管理范围进一步扩大。

title.en: 腾讯混元团队更迭：前OpenAI研究员田永龙成为混元多模态负责人，向姚顺雨汇报
title.zh: 腾讯混元团队更迭：前OpenAI研究员田永龙成为混元多模态负责人，向姚顺雨汇报

body.en: Tencent reorganized its Hunyuan team, naming former OpenAI researcher Tian Yonglong as head of multimodal, reporting to Shunyu Yao as the unit's leading scientist.
body.zh: 腾讯对混元团队进行调整，前OpenAI研究员田永龙出任多模态负责人，向作为该部门首席科学家的姚顺雨汇报。

title.en: 消息称田永龙进入腾讯CEO办公室 直接向姚顺雨汇报
title.zh: 消息称田永龙进入腾讯CEO办公室 直接向姚顺雨汇报

body.en: Reports say Tian Yonglong has joined Tencent's CEO office and now reports directly to Yao, pointing to an expansion of Yao's organizational reach as Tencent's chief AI scientist.
body.zh: 据报道田永龙已进入腾讯CEO办公室并直接向姚顺雨汇报，显示姚顺雨作为腾讯首席AI科学家的管理范围有所扩大。

title.en: OpenAI前研究员田永龙被曝进入腾讯CEO办公室 向腾讯首席AI科学家姚顺雨汇报
title.zh: OpenAI前研究员田永龙被曝进入腾讯CEO办公室 向腾讯首席AI科学家姚顺雨汇报

body.en: Reports say former OpenAI researcher Tian Yonglong has joined Tencent's CEO office and now reports to Shunyu Yao, pointing to an expansion of Yao's reach as Tencent's chief AI scientist.
body.zh: 据报道，前OpenAI研究员田永龙已进入腾讯CEO办公室并向姚顺雨汇报，显示姚顺雨作为腾讯首席AI科学家的管理范围正在扩大。

title.en: 腾讯混元团队更迭：前OpenAI研究员田永龙成为混元多模态负责人 向姚顺雨汇报
title.zh: 腾讯混元团队更迭：前OpenAI研究员田永龙成为混元多模态负责人 向姚顺雨汇报

title.en: 姚顺雨正面回应为何选择加入腾讯：最重要的原因是文化
title.zh: 姚顺雨正面回应为何选择加入腾讯：最重要的原因是文化

body.en: Yao publicly explained his decision to leave OpenAI for Tencent, saying company culture was the most important factor behind the move.
body.zh: 姚顺雨公开回应从OpenAI转投腾讯的原因，称文化是他做出这一选择最重要的考量。

title.en: 腾讯汤道生对谈姚顺雨：智能体时代，模型与产品如何Co-Design
title.zh: 腾讯汤道生对谈姚顺雨：智能体时代，模型与产品如何Co-Design

body.en: Tencent's Tang Daosheng held a public dialogue with Shunyu Yao on how models and products should be co-designed in the agent era, reflecting his role leading Tencent's foundation model research.
body.zh: 腾讯汤道生与姚顺雨就智能体时代模型与产品应如何协同设计展开对谈，体现了他在腾讯基础模型研究方面的领导角色。

title.en: 汤道生承认腾讯业务线快慢不一，姚顺雨透露AI下半场主攻三方向|腾讯云|龙虾|产业|科学家|长跑_手机新浪网
title.zh: 汤道生承认腾讯业务线快慢不一，姚顺雨透露AI下半场主攻三方向|腾讯云|龙虾|产业|科学家|长跑_手机新浪网

body.en: Shunyu Yao outlined Tencent AI's three strategic priorities for the second half, as Tencent Cloud's Tang Daosheng acknowledged uneven progress across business lines.
body.zh: 姚顺雨透露腾讯AI下半年将主攻三大方向，腾讯云汤道生同时承认各业务线进展快慢不一。

title.en: 腾讯AI慢了吗？姚顺雨回应汤道生：感觉应该是我问你的问题
title.zh: 腾讯AI慢了吗？姚顺雨回应汤道生：感觉应该是我问你的问题

body.en: Shunyu Yao publicly pushed back on Tencent Cloud head Tang Daosheng's suggestion that Tencent's AI is lagging, turning the question back on him.
body.zh: 面对腾讯云负责人汤道生关于腾讯AI落后的说法，姚顺雨公开回应反问对方，进行了正面交锋。

title.en: 姚顺雨谈AI下半场：从“寻找方法”到“寻找问题”，直言中国企业“爱刷榜”
title.zh: 姚顺雨谈AI下半场：从“寻找方法”到“寻找问题”，直言中国企业“爱刷榜”

body.en: Yao argued AI's 'second half' is shifting from finding methods to finding problems, and said bluntly that Chinese companies are too focused on chasing benchmark leaderboards.
body.zh: 姚顺雨提出AI“下半场”正从“寻找方法”转向“寻找问题”，并直言中国企业过于热衷“刷榜”。

title.en: AI下半场拼什么？汤道生姚顺雨深度对谈！
title.zh: AI下半场拼什么？汤道生姚顺雨深度对谈！

body.en: Shunyu Yao held an in-depth public dialogue with Tencent Cloud's Tang Daosheng on what matters most in AI's next phase.
body.zh: 姚顺雨与腾讯云汤道生就AI下半场的核心竞争点进行了深度对谈。

title.en: 姚顺雨交作业 腾讯迈出“混元重建第一步”
title.zh: 姚顺雨交作业 腾讯迈出“混元重建第一步”

body.en: Shunyu Yao delivered his first concrete work at Tencent, marking the initial step in rebuilding the Hunyuan model line under his leadership.
body.zh: 姚顺雨交出在腾讯的首份"作业"，标志着腾讯混元大模型重建工作迈出第一步。

title.en: 大厂最年轻AI一号位姚顺雨交卷：入职腾讯4个月，一边纠偏一边降价
title.zh: 大厂最年轻AI一号位姚顺雨交卷：入职腾讯4个月，一边纠偏一边降价

body.en: Four months into leading Tencent's merged foundation-model unit, Shunyu Yao gave an update on progress, including course corrections and price cuts.
body.zh: 姚顺雨执掌腾讯合并后的大模型部门四个月后交出阶段性成果，包括战略纠偏和降价举措。

title.en: 姚顺雨带队三个月重构混元，Hy3 preview 上线了
title.zh: 姚顺雨带队三个月重构混元，Hy3 preview 上线了

body.en: Shunyu Yao led a three-month rebuild of Tencent's Hunyuan model, shipping the Hy3 preview.
body.zh: 姚顺雨带队用三个月时间重构腾讯混元大模型，推出了Hy3预览版。

title.en: 腾讯AI合二为一，姚顺雨第一个大模型混元3.0 稳了？
title.zh: 腾讯AI合二为一，姚顺雨第一个大模型混元3.0 稳了？

body.en: Following Tencent's merger of its AI teams, Yao is leading development of the group's first flagship model, Hunyuan 3.0.
body.zh: 腾讯AI团队合并后，姚顺雨正带领团队打造合并后的首个旗舰大模型混元3.0。

title.en: 让AI从上下文中学习为何这么难？腾讯姚顺雨团队发布最新研究
title.zh: 让AI从上下文中学习为何这么难？腾讯姚顺雨团队发布最新研究

body.en: Shunyu Yao's team at Tencent published new research on why in-context learning is difficult for AI models.
body.zh: 姚顺雨在腾讯的团队发布了关于AI模型为何难以进行上下文学习的最新研究。

title.en: 姚顺雨腾讯首篇论文：给AI下半场指路“上下文学习”
title.zh: 姚顺雨腾讯首篇论文：给AI下半场指路“上下文学习”

body.en: Coverage of Shunyu Yao's first paper published since joining Tencent, on using in-context learning to guide AI's 'second half.'
body.zh: 报道姚顺雨加入腾讯后发表的首篇论文，探讨用"上下文学习"为AI下半场指路。

title.en: 姚顺雨、唐杰、林俊旸、杨强同台发声：中国大模型集体迈向“做事时代”
title.zh: 姚顺雨、唐杰、林俊旸、杨强同台发声：中国大模型集体迈向“做事时代”

body.en: Yao appeared alongside Tang Jie, Lin Junyang and Yang Qiang to argue China's large-model industry is collectively shifting into an 'agentic, doing-things' era.
body.zh: 姚顺雨与唐杰、林俊旸、杨强同台发声，认为中国大模型行业正集体迈向“做事”的智能体时代。
